draw_context: *draw.Context(...), which an app gets from cx.drawing()

types.name: text.Align
types.doc: Placement of the text's extent inside the rect on one axis.

types.name: text.Cache
types.doc: The glyph cache: an atlas mirror and its table, which `text.place` draws through; a draw context holds one as `text`.

fields.name: scale_120
fields.doc: Display scale for this frame's draw, in 1/120 units.

fields.name: zoom
fields.doc: The glyph zoom of the open canvas (section 2a), 1 outside one.

fields.name: drawn_scale_120
fields.doc: `scale_120` at the last `begin_frame`; 0 before the first.

fields.name: new_count
fields.doc: Glyphs rasterized since `begin_frame`.

fields.name: pending
fields.doc: Glyphs skipped this frame that a later frame will draw.

fields.name: overflow_count
fields.doc: Glyphs skipped this frame that no reset can fit (thrash guard).

fields.name: icon_missing
fields.doc: `text.icon` calls this frame whose codepoint the face does not map (`text/layout.zig`, section 3a), and the last of them as `face << 21 | codepoint`.

fields.name: epoch
fields.doc: Resets so far.

fields.name: fresh
fields.doc: True when this frame began with an empty table.

types.name: text.Face
types.doc: The embedded faces, generated per app (section 2b): `sans`, `sans_bold`, and `mono` at 0, 1, and 2, then the app's own.

types.name: text.Glyph
types.doc: One codepoint of a laid-out text (`Glyphs`).

fields.name: pen
fields.doc: The unsnapped pen and baseline, logical px.

fields.name: advance
fields.doc: The font's advance, untracked: the next pen on the line is `pen[0] + (advance + text.tracking_px(style))`.

fields.name: index
fields.doc: The nth codepoint yielded, from 0.

types.name: text.Glyphs
types.doc: The codepoints of a line or a wrapped block with their unsnapped pens.

fields.name: lines
fields.doc: The wrapped lines; null for a single line.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: The wrapped block's x, width, and alignment; a single line's pen starts at `x`.

fields.name: y
fields.doc: The baseline of a single line; the top of the next wrapped line.

fields.name: active
fields.doc: The line being walked, if any.

fields.name: spin_cap
fields.doc: Loop turns one `next` may take: every turn moves a position, a run, or a line.

types.name: text.Options
types.doc: `ellipsis` cuts text wider than the rect and ends it with U+2026 so it fits.

types.name: text.Run
types.doc: One styled span of a line for `place_runs`.

types.name: text.Style
types.doc: How a run of text looks.

fields.name: tracking
fields.doc: Extra advance after every codepoint, in ems of `size`, in `[0, tracking_max]`.

types.name: text.WrapOptions
types.doc: Where wrapped text sits in its rect: each line by `align_x`, the block of lines by `align_y`.

types.name: text.cache.Entry
types.doc: Where one rasterized glyph lives and how it sits on the pen.

types.name: text.ttf.Font
types.doc: Offsets and metrics of one parsed face.

fields.name: ascent
fields.doc: Font units above the baseline (`hhea.ascender`).

fields.name: descent
fields.doc: Font units below the baseline, positive (`-hhea.descender`).

fields.name: line_gap
fields.doc: Font units between one line's descent and the next line's ascent (`hhea.lineGap`, at least 0).

fields.name: cmap
fields.doc: Offset of the chosen `cmap` subtable.

fields.name: ascii
fields.doc: Glyph ids of codepoints 0 to 127, resolved at compile time.

tags.name: empty
tags.doc: No points: the glyph has no ink.

tags.name: replace
tags.doc: Unsupported or over a cap; draw `replacement` instead.

types.name: text.ttf.Outline
types.doc: One decoded outline in font units.

constants.name: text.byte_cap
constants.doc: Bytes of UTF-8 one `place` or `place_runs` call may lay out.

constants.name: text.run_cap
constants.doc: Runs one `place_runs` call may lay out.

constants.name: text.tracking_max
constants.doc: Largest `Style.tracking` in ems: wider than a Noto Sans space, so more would be a layout of single letters rather than letter spacing.

constants.name: text.face_cap
constants.doc: Faces the glyph cache key holds (`text/cache.zig`, section 2).

constants.name: text.ttf.point_cap
constants.doc: Points one outline may hold after composite flattening.

constants.name: text.ttf.contour_cap
constants.doc: Contours one outline may hold after composite flattening.

constants.name: text.ttf.depth_cap
constants.doc: Nesting depth of composite glyphs the flattening stack holds.

constants.name: text.ttf.component_cap
constants.doc: Component records one composite may expand into, all levels together.

constants.name: text.ttf.glyph_cap
constants.doc: Glyph ids must fit the 12-bit glyph field of the cache key.

constants.name: text.ttf.replacement
constants.doc: The glyph drawn in place of one that cannot be loaded: `.notdef`, a box in Noto.

functions.name: text.FaceSet
functions.doc: The per-frame tables of `faces`, one face per token class.

functions.name: text.tracking_px
functions.doc: The extra advance after each codepoint of `style`, in logical pixels: `tracking * size`.

functions.name: text.measure
functions.doc: Width of `utf8` in `style`, in logical pixels: the pen after the text, the sum of its advances plus one tracking gap per codepoint.

functions.name: text.index_at
functions.doc: The codepoint boundary of `utf8` nearest to `x` logical pixels from the pen start.

functions.name: text.place
functions.doc: Lays out `utf8` in `rect` and appends one `draw.Glyph` per inked glyph to `cx`, each with `clip`.

functions.name: text.place_runs
functions.doc: Lays out `runs` as one line sharing a baseline.

functions.name: text.line_height
functions.doc: The line pitch of `style` in whole logical pixels: ascent, descent, and line gap, rounded up.

functions.name: text.measure_wrapped
functions.doc: The height `utf8` in `style` takes wrapped to `width`: lines times the line height.

functions.name: text.measure_runs_wrapped
functions.doc: `measure_wrapped` for runs: the block's line height is the tallest run's.

functions.name: text.place_wrapped
functions.doc: Lays out `utf8` wrapped to `rect.width`, one snapped baseline per line; lines outside `clip` append nothing.

functions.name: text.place_runs_wrapped
functions.doc: `place_wrapped` for runs: a run boundary is not a break opportunity.

functions.name: text.icon
functions.doc: Draws one glyph with its ink box centred on a rect: an icon from an icon face.

functions.name: text.contours
functions.doc: One glyph's outline into a `draw.fill.Builder`, where `glyph` is a glyph id of `face`, from `text.ttf.glyph_id(text.font_of(face), codepoint)`.

functions.name: text.place_outlines
functions.doc: `place` with each glyph a `draw.Fill` shape: display text that rotates, grows past `size_max`, and morphs.

functions.name: text.place_runs_outlines
functions.doc: `place_runs`' layout with one `draw.Fill` shape per glyph, non-zero, in the glyph's colour.

functions.name: text.place_wrapped_outlines
functions.doc: `place_wrapped` as outlines; see `place_runs_wrapped_outlines`.

functions.name: text.place_runs_wrapped_outlines
functions.doc: `place_runs_wrapped`' layout as outlines (`place_runs_outlines`).

functions.name: text.covers
functions.doc: True when `face` maps `codepoint` to a glyph other than `.notdef`: what `place` draws as itself rather than as a box.

functions.name: text.font_of
functions.doc: The face record of `face`.

functions.name: text.size_key
functions.doc: The cache size key of an em of `size` logical pixels at `scale_120`: quarter device px.

functions.name: text.Cache.init
functions.doc: An empty cache at scale 1.

functions.name: text.Cache.device_scale
functions.doc: Device pixels per logical (or, in a canvas, world) pixel of text drawn now: `scale_120 / 120 * zoom` (section 2a).

functions.name: text.Cache.size_key_of
functions.doc: The size key of an em of `size` pixels drawn now: `size * zoom` at the frame's scale.

functions.name: text.Cache.begin_frame
functions.doc: Starts a frame's draw: resets if owed, zeroes the per-frame counters, and records the scale the frame draws at.

functions.name: text.Cache.owes_draw
functions.doc: True when the scene must be drawn again even if the app is clean: the display scale differs from the last draw's, or glyphs were skipped that a frame can still draw.

functions.name: text.Cache.miss_icon
functions.doc: The entry for `glyph` of `face` at `size_q`, rasterizing it on a miss.

functions.name: text.Cache.glyph
functions.doc: The cache entry of `glyph_id` of `face` at `size_q` quarter device pixels, rasterizing it on a miss; null when this frame's budget or the atlas is spent (section 3).

functions.name: text.Cache.queue_upload
functions.doc: Queues the dirty rectangle of the mirror as one strided write to texture 0.

functions.name: text.Glyphs.line
functions.doc: The layout of `place_runs`.

functions.name: text.Glyphs.wrapped
functions.doc: The layout of `place_runs_wrapped`.

functions.name: text.Glyphs.next
functions.doc: The next codepoint, spaces included, or null after the last.

functions.name: text.ttf.parse
functions.doc: Parses `bytes` at compile time.

functions.name: text.ttf.read
functions.doc: `parse` at run time, for tests that read a face built at run time (`text/subset.zig`).

functions.name: text.ttf.glyph_id
functions.doc: Glyph id for `codepoint`; 0 when the face does not map it.

functions.name: text.ttf.advance
functions.doc: Advance width of `glyph` in font units.

functions.name: text.ttf.load
functions.doc: Decodes `glyph` into `out`, flattening composites.
